newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc ends slow session mixed.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc ends slow session mixed.

text.p: 1615 GMT - The Swiss franc closed slightly higher on the dollar but down on the mark after sticking to established ranges for most of the day.

Dealers expected the franc to hold steady above support until year's end. But some said increased volatility could not be ruled out due to reduced volumes in the market. * Dollar closes at 1.3348/3358 francs vs prior 1.3383/3388 * Mark ends at 85.90/93 centimes vs 85.84/87 -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
